title: Visit Huckstash 2

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You came back in one piece. I'm surprised.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You came back in one piece. I'm surprised.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: DeeDee seemed very nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: DeeDee seemed very nice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah I can see why you don't want to speak to her...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah I can see why you don't want to speak to her...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah I can see why you don't want to speak to her...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah I can see why you don't want to speak to her...

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we were friends for a long time. Did she reply to my note?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, we were friends for a long time. Did she reply to my note?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Never talk about DeeDee like that! She's ten times the human you or I will ever be! Did she reply to my note?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never talk about DeeDee like that! She's ten times the human you or I will ever be! Did she reply to my note?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She did, I hope you can see things from her perspective.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She did, I hope you can see things from her perspective.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She did, I hope you can see things from her perspective.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She did, I hope you can see things from her perspective.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She did.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Did you listen to it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you listen to it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, none of my business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, none of my business.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You listened to it? That was private information you Oogle imposter!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You listened to it? That was private information you Oogle imposter!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should have encrypted it better then...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should have encrypted it better then...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should have encrypted it better then...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should have encrypted it better then...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just wanted to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just wanted to help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I should have respected you both.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, I should have respected you both.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry, I should have respected you both.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry, I should have respected you both.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Well I guess you know what you know now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I guess you know what you know now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: DeeDee still clearly has feelings for you. She just can't live her life on the tracks anymore. You should go and see her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: DeeDee still clearly has feelings for you. She just can't live her life on the tracks anymore. You should go and see her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: DeeDee still clearly has feelings for you. She just can't live her life on the tracks anymore. You should go and see her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: DeeDee still clearly has feelings for you. She just can't live her life on the tracks anymore. You should go and see her.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Thank you. There's been some...Er... Sensitive stuff in there. Real raw potatoes. I don't have the fingers to encrypt things these days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. There's been some...Er... Sensitive stuff in there. Real raw potatoes. I don't have the fingers to encrypt things these days.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Gahhh that stubborn old tree trunk. Putting rubber to pavement just isn't in my blood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Gahhh that stubborn old tree trunk. Putting rubber to pavement just isn't in my blood.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You really are the Corpster I took you for on day one. Leave here and don't come back!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really are the Corpster I took you for on day one. Leave here and don't come back!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe not yet, but there is a home for you there. I can feel it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe not yet, but there is a home for you there. I can feel it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe not yet, but there is a home for you there. I can feel it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe not yet, but there is a home for you there. I can feel it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right, you should follow your gut. DeeDee Isn't worth giving this all up for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right, you should follow your gut. DeeDee Isn't worth giving this all up for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right, you should follow your gut. DeeDee Isn't worth giving this all up for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right, you should follow your gut. DeeDee Isn't worth giving this all up for.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Maybe you're right. It has been a long time. I'll reach out to her. Myself this time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you're right. It has been a long time. I'll reach out to her. Myself this time.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: If DeeDee wants to see me before I take the last wind. She'll have to come here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If DeeDee wants to see me before I take the last wind. She'll have to come here!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope you got what you wanted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope you got what you wanted.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope you got what you wanted.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope you got what you wanted.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Depends. Riddle me this, if you had two paths ahead of you, one old and crumbling but shared by another and one brand new but empty, which would you choose?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Depends. Riddle me this, if you had two paths ahead of you, one old and crumbling but shared by another and one brand new but empty, which would you choose?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would take the road with the company.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would take the road with the company.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would take the road with the company.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would take the road with the company.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Give me the smoothest ride possible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give me the smoothest ride possible.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Give me the smoothest ride possible.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Give me the smoothest ride possible.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Thank you. That's very helpful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. That's very helpful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Huckstash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Huckstash.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Huckleberry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Huckleberry.
